title: Why ZUBA? Why Now?
author: ZUBA Team
excerpt: Africa has always had the stories. ZUBA is here to make sure the world finally plays them, watches them and owns a piece of them.
body:
For generations, the world's biggest animated films and games have borrowed from everywhere. Norse gods, Greek heroes, Japanese spirits and Arthurian knights all have their franchises.

Africa, the oldest storyteller on Earth, has mostly waited at the door.

## The stories were always here

Anansi outwitted the Sky God. Sundiata rose from the dust to found an empire. Heroes like Lumumba and Sankara gave everything for a continent that could stand upright. These are not side quests. They are main storylines.

## Why a token?

Because the people who believe in a story should be able to own a part of it. ZUBA is community-driven: holders are not an audience, they are the village that builds the world.

## What happens next

Follow the [roadmap](/roadmap), read the [Developer Notebook](/dev-notes) and join the village. The Motherland has entered the game.
